payload.title: Newsroom app: article image upload and insertion
payload.description: ## Goal Image upload in the article editor: pick a file, it is stored in the site's media bucket, registered as a `MediaAsset` of the article, and an `::image{...}` line is inserted at the cursor; the preview shows the real image. Same data shape the importer produces, so import, export and publish treat editor-uploaded images identically. ## Context (verified) - `PPY-22a3b4` defines the media contract: `MediaAsset { id: "media--", itemId, type: "image", role, sortKey: "NNN#", storagePath: "media/", alt, width, height, metadata: {"srcPath": "assets/<...>", "sha256", "bytes", "contentType"} }`, with `srcPath` relative (`assets//`) and referenced in the body as `::image{src="assets//" alt="..." layout="inline"}`. `PPY-b3a10e` publish copies media to `PublishedMediaAsset` and refuses a body whose relative `src` has no media row (`image-missing`). - Storage rules (`amplify/storage/resource.ts`): `media/*` is read/write/delete for groups `editor`/`admin`, readable by guests/authenticated. Browser upload API: `uploadData` from `aws-amplify/storage` (used in `amplify/seed/seed.ts`); signed URLs: `getUrl` from `aws-amplify/storage` (see `lib/reader-storage-url.ts`, `lib/image-url.ts` for the repo's URL handling). - Editor and preview components come from `PPY-8ef4ca` (`components/newsroom-article-editor.tsx`, `components/markus-ir-preview.tsx`). `MediaAsset` model: `models.MediaAsset.create/list` with `authMode: "userPool"` (editor group has CRUD). ## Exact changes 1. `lib/newsroom-media.ts` (new): `srcPathFor(slug, filename)` -> `assets//` (lowercase, `[a-z0-9._-]`, unique within the item by `-2` suffix); `mediaIdFor(itemId, srcPath)` (SHA-256 via `crypto.subtle`, hex first 10 chars of `sha256(srcPath)`: MUST equal the Python `hashlib.sha256(path.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]` in `markus_import.py`; shared fixture `scripts/fixtures/media-id-cases.json` with 5 `{itemId, srcPath, expected}` rows used by both tests); `validateImageFile(file)` (png jpg jpeg gif webp avif svg, <= 10 MB); `imageDirective(srcPath, alt)` -> `::image{src="..." alt="..." layout="inline"}`. 2. `components/newsroom-article-editor.tsx`: `Insert image` button (enabled only after the first successful save, because `MediaAsset.itemId` needs the item): hidden ``; on selection: validate, compute sha256 of the bytes, read width/height with `createImageBitmap` (skip for svg), `uploadData({ path: "media/" + srcPath, data: file, options: { contentType } })`, `models.MediaAsset.create({ ...fields per PPY-22a3b4, authMode: "userPool" })`, insert `imageDirective(...)` at the textarea selection on its own line, focus the textarea and select the empty `alt=""` value. Failure shows an inline error and leaves the body unchanged. 3. `components/markus-ir-preview.tsx`: image token -> `` from a signed `getUrl({ path: "media/" + srcPath })` when a `MediaAsset` with that `srcPath` exists in the item's media list (fetched by `listMediaAssetsByItemAndSortKey`), else the placeholder; `loading="lazy"`, `alt` from the directive. 4. Python side check only: add `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_media_id_parity.py` reading `scripts/fixtures/media-id-cases.json` and asserting the importer's `media_id_for(item_id, src_path)` (extract this tiny function in `markus_import.py` if not already a function) returns `expected`. ## Data shapes Inserted line: `::image{src="assets/my-post/diagram.png" alt="" layout="inline"}`. MediaAsset row as in `PPY-22a3b4` with `role: "body"`, `alt: ""` (the markup's `alt` is the real alt text). ## Tests - TS unit `scripts/test-newsroom-media.ts` (tsx): `srcPathFor` sanitizing and de-duplication, `validateImageFile` accept/reject cases, `mediaIdFor` against `scripts/fixtures/media-id-cases.json`, `imageDirective` escaping of quotes in alt. - Python: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.test_media_id_parity -v`. - Gherkin (cucumber, demo mode; the demo content-actions fake and an in-memory upload stub): extend `features/newsroom-articles.feature` with "Inserting an image adds an image directive at the cursor" (Playwright `setInputFiles` with a 1x1 PNG fixture `features/fixtures/pixel.png`; expect the body to contain `::image{src="assets/`), and "Insert image is disabled until the article is saved". - Sandbox: upload a real PNG as editor; `poetry run papyrus content publish --id ` succeeds (no `image-missing`); `export-published` writes `assets//`. ## Acceptance checks - `npx tsx scripts/test-newsroom-media.ts`, `test_media_id_parity`, the cucumber feature, `npx tsc --noEmit` pass. - Sandbox flow above works end to end: the uploaded image appears in the published export and in the editor preview. ## Dependencies Blocked by `PPY-8ef4ca` (same components), `PPY-22a3b4` (media contract / `media_id_for`), `PPY-b3a10e` (publish gate). Same-file conflicts: `newsroom-article-editor.tsx`, `markus-ir-preview.tsx` (do not run in parallel with `PPY-8ef4ca`). ## Risks - Client-side hash of the path, not the bytes: re-uploading a different file under the same name overwrites (same `srcPath`); the `sha256` in metadata is of the bytes. Acceptable (names are unique per item through `srcPathFor`). - Orphaned S3 objects when an editor removes the directive: no cleanup in Phase 2 (YAGNI). - SVG uploads can carry scripts: they are served from the media bucket as images (``), never inline; keep it that way (do not render SVG inline in the preview). ## Needs Ryan Nothing. ## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket) - Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/ -b feature/PPY-ad5ca4- origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output. - `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only). - Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here. - Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests. -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:` in package.json). - Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
